span.p:
DIRECT lung injury
pneumonia · aspiration
inhalation · contusion

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Alveolar-capillary barrier breaks down
endothelium + type I pneumocyte

div.style: color: rgb(120, 53, 15) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
INDIRECT injury
sepsis · pancreatitis
trauma · transfusion (TRALI)

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Neutrophils recruited
proteases · oxidants
cytokines: IL-1, IL-6, IL-8

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
PROTEIN-RICH edema floods alveoli
(high-permeability, NOT high pressure)

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Type II pneumocytes killed
surfactant inactivated

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Alveoli perfused but NOT ventilated
= SHUNT

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Lung becomes small + stiff
= the BABY LUNG

div.style: color: rgb(12, 74, 110) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
REFRACTORY HYPOXEMIA
does not fix with FiO2 alone

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Low compliance
every breath over-stretches
the little lung that is left = VILI

div.style: color: rgb(136, 19, 55) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Rising PaCO2
high VD/VT predicts death

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PEEP + PRONE
recruit the flooded lung

div.style: color: rgb(6, 78, 59) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6 mL/kg PBW · Pplat under 30
driving pressure under 15
